rename.name: Rename nodes
rename.help: Apply rules from top to bottom. Enter a pattern on the left and replacement text on the right. Leave the replacement empty to remove matched text.

filter.name: Filter nodes
filter.excludeOffHelp: Off (default): keep nodes that match the rules
filter.excludeOnHelp: On: exclude nodes that match the rules
filter.help: Match any name pattern. Selected protocols must also match. Enable exclusion to remove matching nodes.
filter.protocolsPlaceholder: Select protocols, or leave empty for all

extractNodes.name: Extract subscription nodes
extractNodes.help: Accept text and parse it using the selected subscription format into a node list. Connect any text output, including HTTP request and Field input nodes.
